copyStrategy: One giant numeral per state with a short bold label: '48' teams, '12' groups, '32' advance, '1' champion, closing on the 104-match headline.
narrativeArc: A hot mosaic field of tiles fills the frame as 48 teams, snaps into 12 group blocks, drives into a bold knockout ladder as it narrows to 32, then converges on one oversized champion numeral beside the 104-match headline.
visualThesis: A field of hot red-and-orange mosaic tiles is the persistent world, in a loud broadcast register borrowed only from the tournament's design energy (never its marks). Oversized numerals dominate each beat; the same tiles re-form from swarm to groups to ladder to a single champion.
